title: Implement reviewed Profile promotion candidates
goal: Emit hash-bound extension inputs for immutable sibling composition without performing Target adoption composition selection CI activation publication or merge.
acceptanceCriteria: Promotion revalidates exact current Target draft review Profile Module configuration capability and fixture bindings.
The candidate extension bundle and promotion receipt are deterministic schema-valid and atomically written outside TargetRoot.
The existing immutable sibling composer accepts the emitted bundle when supplied separately authorized base and composition inputs.
TargetRoot remains byte-identical and no composition selection CI remote or release action occurs.
risks: A candidate bundle could be mistaken for adopted Target governance or a selected installed composition.
decisions: Emit a candidate and explicit boundary receipt; keep every Target and composition apply transaction separate.
